key_finding: NONE of the 18 IDENTITY_REVIEW_FIRST rows can have its street address filled from evidence this market already holds: 17 have no address in the shadow recensus either, and the one that does carries a route that disagrees with the registered one. So the remaining identity work is a free attended capture pass -- one visit per property to read the street off its own page -- not a mechanical enrichment. That is why this order stops here rather than claiming the cohort is closeable at no effort.
why_paid_is_still_closed: Every remaining row is blocked on a ROUTE or an ADDRESS, and buying a page supplies neither. Two routes retired in this order pointed at a domain reseller and at a hotel seventy miles away in another county; paying to fetch either would have bought the wrong building's policy.
